description: This Java source file defines a REST controller `HelloController` for a Spring Boot application. It provides basic endpoints including a welcome message, documentation redirect, health status, and application info, with Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller for basic endpoints including hello, documentation redirect, health check, and info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Handles GET requests at root '/' and returns a welcome message.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Handles GET requests at '/docs' and redirects to Swagger UI, constructing the URL based on the incoming HttpServletRequest.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Handles GET requests at '/health' and returns the application health status.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Handles GET requests at '/api/info' and returns basic application information.
